text:
ITEM 1 | Thin, flat, crispy strips with reddish-brown caramelized edges and darker glossy spots, slightly curled and layered, two long pieces plus a third overlapping strip, each about 8-10 cm long and 1-1.5 cm wide, covering roughly 12% of the plate's visible area, sitting at the upper center-right of the plate | 25 g

ITEM 2 | Small blueberries, dark navy-purple with a matte-to-slightly-waxy skin and a visible crown on each berry, about 1-1.5 cm diameter, clustered in a loose mound of roughly 30-35 berries covering about 10% of the plate, lower right of the plate, partly tucked under the strawberry pieces | 35 g

ITEM 3 | Two strawberry pieces: one wedge-shaped half with bright red flesh, glossy juicy surface and pale core, about 4 cm long and 2.5 cm thick, and one smaller rounded piece, about 2 cm across, bright red with slight moisture, both sitting among the blueberries on the lower right | 30 g
